headline: Meta's Muse AI agent launches in the UK after CMA talks
dek: Meta launched Muse, its personal AI agent, in the UK on November 24. The Competition and Markets Authority said Meta changed its terms and conditions to make them fairer for consumers after talks with the regulator, and that it will keep reviewing how Muse is presented and works. The CMA expects similar agents to reach the UK in the coming months.
why: An agent that can act on a shopper's behalf will read your product pages without looking at your photos the way a person does. The CMA is watching consumer protection, so agent shopping in the UK will come with regulator attention from the start.
doThis: If you sell online in the UK, open three product pages and check that the name, price, stock status and shipping details are written as plain text on the page, not only inside images.
